title: Mid-level UX/UI product designer
description: A 4-year UX/UI designer (Figma, design systems, user research) evaluated against 8 postings: one strong senior product-design match with clear gaps, one semantic match written in tool-agnostic vocabulary, one marginal brand-design role, and five distractors including two 'designer'-titled jobs from unrelated families.
rationale: j2 is a genuinely good product-design fit expressed in deliberately generic, tool-agnostic vocabulary — 'a modern interface prototyping tool', 'evidence-based usability practice', 'reusable interface component libraries' — that never names Figma, Sketch, design systems, user research, or wireframing, so it shares near-zero tokens with the resume's skill list; TF-IDF has almost no signal while embeddings should recognize the same competency. j3 probes the graded boundary: real overlap on Adobe Illustrator, Figma, and visual craft, but the job family is brand/print design rather than product UX, so it is marginal (grade 1). j5 (interior designer) and j6 (mechanical design engineer) are lexical distractors that share only the word 'design' with the resume and belong to entirely different professions. Gap target j1 overlaps strongly on Figma, design systems, research, and usability testing, while demanding motion design and quantitative product analytics the resume clearly lacks, plus preferred Framer and HTML/CSS prototyping (the latter only partially covered by a volunteer project).

jobs.raw_text:
Senior Product Designer — Harborlight Software (Remote, US)

Harborlight builds billing and invoicing software for small accounting firms. We are hiring a Senior Product Designer to own the billing product area.

What you will do:
- Own end-to-end design for the billing and invoicing product area, from discovery and wireframes to polished UI
- Evolve and govern the Figma design system used by three product squads
- Plan and run usability studies and turn findings into design decisions
- Deliver motion specs for micro-interactions and empty-state animations

Requirements: Figma, design systems, user research and usability testing, motion design (After Effects or Lottie), quantitative product analytics (Amplitude or Mixpanel). 4+ years designing digital products, 2+ years maintaining a production design system. Bachelor's degree in design, HCI, or equivalent practical experience; portfolio demonstrating shipped B2B product work.

Nice to have: Framer, HTML and CSS prototyping, fintech domain experience.

jobs.raw_text:
Product Designer — Fernwick Labs (Hybrid, Chicago IL)

Fernwick Labs makes scheduling software for independent clinics. We are a small team that cares about craft, and we are deliberately tool-agnostic — great designers outlast any particular app.

You will own product design end to end for our scheduling product, from first concept to shipped interface. You will build clickable concept models in whatever modern interface prototyping tool you prefer, watch real people use them, and let the evidence steer the design. Together with engineering you will grow a shared library of reusable interface components so the product stays consistent as it expands.

We look for: end-to-end product design ownership, fluency in a modern interface prototyping tool, evidence-based usability practice, and experience building reusable interface component libraries. 3+ years designing software products. Bonus: designing for assistive-technology users, facilitating collaborative workshops.
